problem:
A numerical method is used to approximate a solution to an initial value problem, resulting in the table below. If the exact solution is $y(x)={e}^{-x},$ find, rounded to three decimal places, the global truncation error at each step.

| $n$ | ${x}_{n}$ | ${y}_{n}$ | ${e}_{n}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $0$ | $0$ | $1$ | $0$ |
| $1$ | $0.2$ | $0.762$ | {{field-1}} |
| $2$ | $0.4$ | $0.558$ | {{field-2}} |
| $3$ | $0.6$ | $0.353$ | {{field-3}} |
